model: Unchanged author DLinear + Identity MLP16 depth3 and original DSOF core via tested causal adapter
optimizer: Exact author Exchange/DLinear_MLP defaults in adapter, no performance-directed tuning
validation: Last 80 fully mature origins strictly before cutoff, train last label strictly before first validation origin
scaler: Scalar mean/std of original observed training-only price prefix ending before validation first origin; never validation or online suffix statistics

pilot.report: Runtime, finite output, steps and shape only; no model selection or published forecast score

formal.selection: Validation mean of h1/h5/h20 native-price MSE/RW_MSE
formal.score_origins: Same-year complete H20 future, all methods paired later only if identical origin/protocol
formal.primary_score: Equal year and h1/h5/h20 native-price MSE/RW_MSE
formal.purpose: Actually execute published original model and learning paths on real development data; execution anchor, not authors complete benchmark reproduction and not sole strength-matched comparator

stop_rule: No retries or rescue hyperparameters after nonfinite result or deadline; preserve all records
storage: Raw inputs, per-origin forecasts/targets and checkpoints local_only due EEX data terms; publish own code, metadata and aggregate metrics only
